verdict.rationale: In-person payments are a fair question for a marketplace payments provider like Mangopay, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers online pay-ins, wallets, payouts, checkout and vault SDKs, and webhooks, but never mentions terminals, POS, or tap-to-pay SDKs settling into seller wallets or reporting. Wallet infrastructure and online checkout components are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder with offline sellers, in-person works on the same stack — terminals or tap-to-pay SDKs that settle into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments
